attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB 10.5 Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9, starting from bare nodes with no MariaDB installed), took the whole cluster down for a maintenance window, and brought it back with all committed writes intact and all three members serving again. Also completed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol for every node, proving changed boot identity and full cluster health recovery after each.
